biggest_catch: Your friend must be a first-time CCNB account holder who presents your completed form in person at account opening - online applications don't count.
catches: Referring customer receives $25 in their existing CCNB account when the friend presents the completed Refer A Friend form while opening a new account.
Friend receives $25 approximately 30 days after opening, if the account is active, funded, and in good standing.
Referred customer must be a first-time CCNB account holder; applies to personal checking and personal savings accounts.
Referrer must not be an owner/co-owner of the new account; the new account owner must live in CCNB's service area.
Cash incentive subject to 1099 tax reporting; offer subject to change or stop without notice.
If referred by more than one client, the earliest date on the form determines who gets the incentive.
No cap stated on the official page.

Friend presents the completed form when opening a new personal checking or savings account.
